description: one-metre clip-on non-structural fiberglass body modules
retention: keyed hook plus captive over-centre clip and independent anti-lift retainer
seal: replaceable dry EPDM compression gasket; no production adhesive cure
structural_role: non-structural weather skin; steel frame remains the certified load path

assembly_plan.activity: Receive three released frames and verify clip-rail datums
Fit dry EPDM seals and inspect keyed clip receptacles
Hang and latch left/right 1 m side modules
Hang and latch 1 m roof modules from mobile access stands
Fit corner closures, skirts, labels, and earth bonds
Water test, rattle check, snag closeout, and QA release
assembly_plan.release_check: dry interior and signed module map
